# AI in Finance Daily — 2026-11-23

*The AI unwind went global over the weekend — and hedge funds are the ones bleeding.*

## 🔎 The lead
**The AI selloff is now a worldwide liquidation, and the smart money got hit first.** Goldman Sachs says its hedge-fund VIP basket — the stocks the pros crowded into — has been crushed, and funds are in full retreat from the AI trade [1](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOWDJVaFF6enpqbU1feG9GclJwS0hhd0xYMkt5Vjh0VEpTLXhIZ1VONm9GbG9GMXhVTzB3ajBwSHpqWUJoVkhVYWtHMDFlVlJNN2N1SHFQR0FTVF9tSllrSjh3NzhxTXd1SlVlbS1wemgwM2d4UGtaWEp3elZhWElTcXNiNVNwQzZh?oc=5), [20](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQSHJZdHZoaXUxbzJWallycDVkbTRSVk9UY1UzS3plTllxTjFFd1k3NFFwRlMwTHBKb1VmV2lRUXgwM3F3NVdtQmlZM1Rxb3hTdzlEMWpkX0F5X2c0MFQwNzFRMmp2TGtZYjFCOXRFS3Q0aEpQeU5ucElBVEl1d0o2QzV6b0g?oc=5). ## ⚡ The big picture
**UBS still sees $1.4 trillion in AI spend next year.** The bank projects global AI investment jumps ~40% to $1.4T in 2027 — while flagging that returns remain the open question [94](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQRkljYWd2WEtjSFhqLW9kZjBqRjRRSGV6aGNPdFFtUFNxVjU2aDZKS2pnX3U1UTBkbHgzdE1zV0NRbE5vd2kxSE8tRDgtS1N4TG0yUmNkSktGcFIxR1hudUM2VTlsYk9rUHFYWlBJRjRTMEhwaTBvV1drOTYxLXRsS1hxSXk1X2FodE0yUXVBR2RhWDBzTy1PT1VOWW5FR09QNzR5SGYtUVBZNXE3b0J4RVMzczZGRHh3b2NIOWlGMmpxWDJi?oc=5), [75](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQcVhwcDdUalEyNDhUZlRuOEhOQlplOUJMRkhWdzRYZGxaRl83LVNYR2EybTlZS3JWYzBtRk9Rd0R3alpVUi1BWU1ZUkV2eHg2OF9Gejg3bmw0V0xXRkVLOFRJV1BGN0F5ajdVNDh0OGNQd24yRDVhVDJnZ09JM2szUDlSWEQ3ZVVpVE1sZWdUQjdDSXhSQ2RxUVhNb1QxTzVUTmRRTUpYc3RHOEhNTEREMGVIb2gxRl85?oc=5).

**UBS flags a $32 trillion grid bill.** The bank says the world needs $32T in electrical-infrastructure spend over the next decade — the physical backbone of the AI buildout [36](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## 💼 Asset management
**Korean ETF shops rotate from SpaceX to Anthropic.** After losses on SpaceX exposure, Korean ETF managers are weighing Anthropic purchases as the next AI vehicle [2](https://news.google.?oc=5). **So what:** Korea keeps playing marginal buyer into every AI dip — the continuity thread from Friday.

**Vanguard's flagship takes the hit anyway.** The All-World ETF slid ~3.3% last week even as €1.2B poured in — passive flows meeting an active drawdown [14](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxNY09IdDBSMEs1RFlhZGM3NTBZU0pMUkZYaFRBaWxIQ01Ganc1ZDdhNTctempQMjdzc0JLRmpab0w5VkxPUHlkYm5fYmFUVnZmWHJwTEVrSi1INWVuMHFQREpJWGFLUDdVTHB5VHZQRHpMQXVKWUk0MWFncE5TS0hENWhKc0RsVlJKcUNvUkNCNlU0alp3WFNrbWo5ai1qNzNUaldRbWVwX2lRRlhwTjhkRlRkY19xNnJ4cm02TnVYNkJOX3hIUHlmbDJrQ3VCUQ?oc=5).
